description: 对合成示例 q1/q2 的关键行数与聚合进行独立复核；第 3 项检查暴露示例库中故意埋设的重复批次（演示用途）。

checks.sql: SELECT reading_id FROM readings WHERE status = 'valid' AND value IS NOT NULL
checks.note: q1 各站点 valid_readings 之和的独立改写：直接对 readings 过滤计数。

checks.sql: SELECT AVG(r.value) FROM readings r WHERE r.status = 'valid' AND r.value IS NOT NULL AND r.site_id IN (SELECT site_id FROM sites WHERE region = 'north')
checks.note: q2 中 region='north' 的 mean_value：原查询为 JOIN + GROUP BY，此处以 IN 子查询独立改写复核。

checks.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM readings WHERE status = 'valid' AND value IS NOT NULL) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT site_id, ts, value FROM readings WHERE status = 'valid' AND value IS NOT NULL))
checks.note: 重复批次检测：朴素计数减去按 (site_id, ts, value) 去重后的计数。结果非 0 即说明存在重复入库，须写入 anomalies。
